title: Housecall Pro Alternatives (2026): 4 Options Compared
description: Jobber, Kickserv, ServiceM8 and Workiz vs Housecall Pro: users included, job caps, card fees and trials, checked Nov 7, 2026.
h1: Housecall Pro alternatives: 4 options compared on price and users
body:
Housecall Pro is a full field-service suite (online booking, scheduling, quotes, invoicing, payments and reviews), but its Basic plan is $59/mo billed annually for 1 user ($79/mo monthly), and teams jump to Essentials at $149/mo annually for 5 users or MAX at $299/mo annually for 8 users ($35/mo per extra user on MAX). If that per-plan user model is too expensive, you need a free solo tier, or you want unlimited users priced another way, these are the alternatives we could verify from each vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-07. Prices are as published; anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown.

{{table:housecall-pro,jobber,kickserv,servicem8,workiz}}

What a solo operator and a 5-person team would pay

Published list prices (billed annually unless noted; monthly no-commitment in brackets):

  • Housecall Pro: 1 user Basic $59/mo ($79). Essentials includes 5 users for $149/mo ($189).
  • Jobber: 1 user Core $29/mo ($49). 5 users on Connect $149/mo ($199).
  • Kickserv: Start includes 5 users for $60/mo ($75). Run includes 10 users for $119/mo ($149).
  • ServiceM8: Free is $0 for 1 user (30 jobs/mo). Paid plans start at Starter $29/mo with unlimited users (50 jobs/mo). Growing is $79/mo (150 jobs). No annual discount listed.
  • Workiz: unknown. Workiz shows "Request pricing" on Standard, Pro and Ultimate.

1. Jobber: the closest like-for-like switch (cheaper for one user)

Jobber covers the same ground as Housecall Pro (online booking, scheduling, quotes, invoices, payments) and prices per user. Core is $29/mo billed annually ($49/mo no commitment) for 1 user — half of Housecall Pro Basic's annual price. Connect is $99/mo annually ($139/mo monthly) for 1 user and adds automated reminders, checklists, quote/invoice follow-ups and QuickBooks Online sync; a 5-user Connect plan is $149/mo annually, the same as Housecall Pro Essentials. Grow is $149/mo annually for 1 user ($199/mo monthly); a 5-user Grow plan is $229/mo annually. Extra users are $29/mo each. Card processing is 2.9% + 30¢ online, Tap to Pay 2.7% + 30¢, ACH 1%. The 14-day trial (on Grow) needs no credit card. For the full head-to-head, read Jobber vs Housecall Pro, or see the full Jobber pricing breakdown. {{aff:jobber|See Jobber plans}}

2. Kickserv: the cheapest published way to put 5–20 people on one account

Kickserv sells flat plans with users included: Start, 5 users, $60/mo billed annually ($75/mo monthly); Run, 10 users, $119/mo annually ($149/mo monthly); Scale, 20 users, $199/mo annually ($249/mo monthly). Start covers an embeddable contact form, automated email and text reminders, 20+ reports, time and expense tracking and QuickBooks Online. Dispatch mapping, GPS check-ins and custom reports start on Run (QuickBooks Desktop is $50/mo extra on Run and up). Payments: Tap to Pay in the app is 2.9% + 30¢, but other online card payments are 3.9% + 30¢ and ACH is 1% + 30¢. Kickserv takes 5% off your subscription (Kickback) if you process at least $1,000/mo in online payments on Start. No contract; annual subscriptions aren't refundable. Its pricing page offers a 30-day free trial (its landscaping page says 14 days), no credit card required. Route optimization isn't listed. See Kickserv pricing details.

3. ServiceM8: free solo tier, then unlimited users by job volume

ServiceM8 prices by monthly job credits, not by user. The Free plan is $0 for 1 user and 30 jobs/mo. Paid plans have unlimited users: Starter $29/mo (50 jobs), Growing $79/mo (150 jobs), Premium $149/mo (500 jobs), Premium Plus $349/mo (1,500+ jobs). No annual discount is listed on the pricing page. Essentials on every plan include scheduling, quoting and invoicing, online bookings, card payments and accounting sync (QuickBooks Online, Xero, MYOB). Auto Routing and a dispatch map are listed; the minimum plan for Auto Routing isn't clearly stated. US card fees via ServiceM8 Pay are 3.05% + 30¢ standard domestic and 4.60% + 30¢ international (help center, listed as current as of Sep 2024). ServiceM8 Phone starts at $19/mo. The 14-day trial needs no credit card, and there are no lock-in contracts. See ServiceM8 pricing details. {{aff:servicem8|See ServiceM8 plans}}

4. Workiz: for phone-heavy businesses, if you'll ask for a quote

Workiz bundles an integrated phone system (call tracking, masking, two-way texting) with scheduling, estimates, invoices, online booking with optional checkout, estimate deposits, consumer financing and QuickBooks Online sync on every plan. Genius Scheduling and custom reports start on Pro; service plans, sales proposals, inventory, checklists, multi-day jobs and Zapier are on Ultimate only. Workiz doesn't publish prices (every plan says "Request pricing"), and its FAQ says annual billing saves $400+. The free trial is 7 days, no credit card required. See Workiz details. {{aff:workiz|Visit Workiz}}

Which Housecall Pro alternative fits you?

  • Solo and price-sensitive: ServiceM8 Free is $0 (30 jobs/mo). Jobber Core is $29/mo billed annually versus Housecall Pro Basic at $59/mo.
  • You're adding crew and want users included: Kickserv Start includes 5 users for $60/mo annually. ServiceM8 paid plans include unlimited users (capped by jobs/mo). Jobber's 5-user Connect matches Housecall Pro Essentials at $149/mo annually.
  • You want the most similar product with a published per-user ladder: Jobber.
  • You take your bookings by phone: Workiz includes a phone system on every plan, but you'll need to request a price. ServiceM8 Phone is an add-on from $19/mo.
  • You take most payments online by card: compare fees as well as subscriptions. Housecall Pro starts at 2.59%, Jobber is 2.9% + 30¢ online, Kickserv is 3.9% + 30¢ except Tap to Pay, and ServiceM8 Pay (US) is 3.05% + 30¢ domestic.
  • Also worth a look for HVAC, plumbing or electrical teams: Service Fusion charges a flat $259/mo (Starter, month-to-month) or $220/mo billed annually, with unlimited users on every plan and QuickBooks Online and Desktop integration. Card processing rates aren't published (checked 2026-11-14). {{aff:servicefusion|See Service Fusion plans}}

Staying with Housecall Pro? See the full Housecall Pro pricing breakdown {{aff:housecallpro|See Housecall Pro plans}}. Also compare Jobber alternatives. Before you switch, run through our software buying checklist (data export and contract terms matter most), and use the job quote estimator to sanity-check your prices. faq: What is the cheapest alternative to Housecall Pro?

Of the tools we checked on 2026-11-07, ServiceM8's Free plan is $0 for 1 user (30 jobs per month). Among paid plans with published prices, Jobber Core is $29/mo billed annually for 1 user, and Kickserv Start is $60/mo billed annually with 5 users included. Housecall Pro Basic is $59/mo billed annually for 1 user.
Which Housecall Pro alternative includes the most users?

ServiceM8 includes unlimited users on every paid plan (Starter and up) and caps you by monthly jobs instead. Kickserv includes 5 users on Start ($60/mo annually), 10 on Run and 20 on Scale. Jobber charges $29/mo per extra user (5-user Connect is $149/mo annually). Housecall Pro includes 5 users on Essentials and 8 on MAX.
Is Jobber cheaper than Housecall Pro?

For one user, yes on published annual prices: Jobber Core is $29/mo billed annually versus Housecall Pro Basic at $59/mo. For five users, they're level on annual billing: Housecall Pro Essentials includes 5 users for $149/mo, the same as Jobber's 5-user Connect plan ($149/mo annually). Prices checked 2026-11-07.
Which Housecall Pro alternatives have a free trial without a credit card?

Jobber (14 days on Grow), Kickserv (30 days per its pricing page; its landscaping page says 14), ServiceM8 (14 days) and Workiz (7 days) all say no credit card is required. Housecall Pro's own trial is 14 days on MAX with no credit card.
Do Housecall Pro alternatives sync with QuickBooks?

Jobber syncs with QuickBooks Online and Xero on Connect and up. Kickserv includes QuickBooks Online on all plans (QuickBooks Desktop is $50/mo extra on Run and up). ServiceM8 lists QuickBooks Online, Xero and MYOB under essentials on all plans. Workiz lists QuickBooks Online sync on all plans. Housecall Pro has QuickBooks Online sync on Essentials and up.
